{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1, 1, 1]}}}, "range": [0, 16], "size": 8.0, "bold": true, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0, 0, 0]}}, "width": 0.08000000000000002}]}], "text": "엔딩을 봤는데요. 제가 눈물이"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1, 1, 1]}}}, "range": [0, 17], "size": 8.0, "bold": true, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0, 0, 0]}}, "width": 0.08000000000000002}]}], "text": "되게 없는 편인데 울진 않았지만"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1, 1, 1]}}}, "range": [0, 13], "size": 8.0, "bold": true, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0, 0, 0]}}, "width": 0.08000000000000002}]}], "text": "대기 시간 때 이걸 하면"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1, 1, 1]}}}, "range": [0, 15], "size": 8.0, "bold": true, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0, 0, 0]}}, "width": 0.08000000000000002}]}], "text": "시간이 되게 금방 가더라고요"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1, 1, 1]}}}, "range": [0, 18], "size": 8.0, "bold": true, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0, 0, 0]}}, "width": 0.08000000000000002}]}], "text": "하고 있는 게임은 최근에 포코피아"}
